title: Natural Language Programming: Rethinking Language, Memory, and Cognition in the Era of Generative AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.23106v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence is transforming the role of natural language in computational systems. In classical Natural Language Processing (NLP), language was treated as an object of computation: something to analyse, classify, translate, or generate. Large Language Models (LLMs) challenge this perspective, enabling natural language to function increasingly as an executable cognitive medium through which humans structure reasoning, orchestrate problem solving, and regulate hybrid human/AI workflows.   This paper introduces Natural Language Programming (NLPg) as a theoretical and epistemological extension of traditional NLP. Rather than focusing on language understanding alone, NLPg conceptualises prompts as dynamic cognitive artefacts that externalise goals, constraints, assumptions, validation criteria, and intermediate reasoning states. Prompting is thus not merely a technical interaction technique, but a form of dialogic cog

translated_title: 自然语言编程：在生成式人工智能时代重新思考语言、记忆与认知
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能正在改变自然语言在计算系统中的角色。在经典的自然语言处理（NLP）中，语言被视为计算的对象，即需要被分析、分类、翻译或生成的东西。大语言模型（LLM）挑战了这一观点，使自然语言越来越作为一种可执行的认知媒介发挥作用，人类通过它来构建推理、组织问题求解，并调节人机混合工作流程。本文提出了自然语言编程（NLPg）这一概念，作为传统NLP在理论和认识论上的延伸。NLPg不仅关注语言理解本身，而是将提示词概念化为一种动态认知制品，它将目标、约束、假设、验证标准和中间推理状态外化出来。因此，提示不再仅仅是一种技术交互手段，而是一种对话式认知的形式。
tldr: 本文提出自然语言编程（NLPg）这一新概念，将提示词重新定义为能够外化目标、约束与推理状态的动态认知制品，主张自然语言正从被计算的对象演变为人类与AI协作中可执行的认知媒介。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Natural Language Programming (NLPg), reconceptualizing prompts as dynamic cognitive artefacts that externalize goals, constraints, and reasoning states, arguing that natural language is evolving from an object of computation into an executable cognitive medium for human-AI collaboration.
